text: -_- thats really lovely so even if i know im going to do an illegal edit, and i want it to split quads, its never going to actually do it
resolution: Split Quads is now real. Host side (framework/gpu/3d.zig): the guard records the indices of the offending tris at gizmo release (g_guard_bad_list); resolve action 0 renumbers every authored quad group containing an offending tri into per-triangle groups — pure group remap, no geometry moves, journaled as 'split quads' so undo restores groups and part ranges. Part membership survives: face-to-part is derived from the ORIGINAL group ids, then the contiguous per-part ranges renormalize (same machinery as detach). canSplit in the guard JSON is honest now — 1 only when a split would change topology (multi-tri group on a source-resident mesh). Cart side (ModelView.tsx): the prompt hides the Split Quads button and trims the message when canSplit=0, and a real split resyncs the outliner part-range mirror and live UV panel. Zig rebuild required; TSX hot-reloads.
